minors.issue: The DSN joins "file:", the raw path and the _pragma query with no escaping, so a '?' or '#' in the data directory changes where modernc splits the path from the pragmas.
minors.scenario: With the data directory /srv/mg?x, the DSN is split at the first '?'. Open then opens the wrong file or fails on an unknown parameter instead of opening /srv/mg?x/agent.db with WAL and synchronous=FULL. The default /var/lib/moonglass is not affected.
